verdict.rationale: Gusto documents regular payroll processing: a 'complete a regular payroll' guide with auto-pre-generated payrolls retrievable via API, platform claims of handling regular payroll runs end-to-end, and pre-built UI flows. Timesheet and payroll prep exist in the CLI, but it only drafts payroll and has no submit command. The evidence never shows a single flow where an ops user reviews hours and earnings, previews totals, and submits; the only documented preview endpoint is for contractor payments. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of hours/earnings review and totals preview for regular payroll, a documented submit step within one unified flow, and hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end run.
